surfaces.name: AceOS
surfaces.start: Start the AceOS HQ server: run `python run_hq_http.py` in the AceOS repo (on the Mac, launchd runs it as com.ace.hq_http).
surfaces.notes: AceOS README.md: dashboard at http://127.0.0.1:8765. /api/capabilities is the unauthenticated smoke check AceOS's own train_autopilot uses; probing it stops the Sovereign daemon (which can also bind :8765 when AceOS is down) from being mistaken for AceOS.

surfaces.name: HQ
surfaces.start: Start the BlackLabel HQ dashboard (BlackLabelHQ repo) so it listens on 127.0.0.1:8791.
surfaces.notes: Port :8791 comes from the lane brief and BlackLabel-Team STATE/research/BACKLOG.md ('HQ dash :8791'). The BlackLabelHQ repo was not readable from the build session, so its start command is not verified here.

surfaces.name: Utah deck
surfaces.start: Start the Utah deck so it serves HTTP on 127.0.0.1:8766.
surfaces.portNote: AceOS's event WebSocket (acesd/core/ws_server.py) also defaults to 127.0.0.1:8766. If the shell reports a WebSocket server here, that is AceOS holding the deck's port.
surfaces.notes: Port :8766 comes from the lane brief and BlackLabel-Team substrate evidence ('Utah deck :8766 HTTP 200'). The deck's start command is not verified from the build session.

surfaces.name: Sovereign
surfaces.start: Start the Sovereign daemon with `sov start` (it ships with the Sovereign daemon kit, a separate install from the app).
surfaces.notes: No fixed port: the daemon writes its bound port (8765-8785, off 8765 when AceOS holds it) to ~/.sovereign/dashboard.port, and /api/health answers {"ok": true}. Source: BlackLabelSovereign Sources/ToolClient.swift. The daemon is launchd-managed on the Mac; whether it runs on Linux or Windows is not verified.

surfaces.name: Real Estate
surfaces.start: Run `node web/server.mjs` in the BlackLabelRealEstate repo (Node 22 or newer).
surfaces.portNote: The port can be moved with BLRE_WEB_PORT; if it was, update this entry's url to match.
surfaces.notes: Lane P3, shflikawgfhlaigrk/BlackLabelRealEstate#4 (draft). Checked against that PR's web/server.mjs: DEFAULT_PORT 4178, loopback only, GET /healthz -> {"ok":true,"service":"blacklabel-realestate-web"}. Its CSP has no frame-ancestors and it sends no X-Frame-Options, so it can be framed.

surfaces.name: Marketing
surfaces.start: Run `npm ci && npm start` in the web folder of the BlackLabelMarketing repo (Node 20 or newer).
surfaces.portNote: The port can be moved with BL_MARKETING_WEB_PORT; if it was, update this entry's url to match.
surfaces.notes: Lane P6, shflikawgfhlaigrk/BlackLabelMarketing#8 (draft). Checked against that PR's web/server/server.mjs: DEFAULT_PORT 47310, binds 127.0.0.1, answers only Host 127.0.0.1:<port> or localhost:<port> (else 421), /api/* needs x-bl-surface: marketing (else 403), GET /api/health -> {"ok":true,"surface":"marketing",...}. / needs no header and sends no frame-blocking header.

surfaces.name: Estate API
surfaces.start: Run `npx wrangler dev` in the BlackLabelRealEstateAPI repo (8787 is wrangler's default dev port).
surfaces.notes: JSON API, not a dashboard: GET / returns health. Real data needs the PG :5433 corpus locally or the founder-gated managed-PG deploy.
